source: Quiz 4 - Sessions 1-5: Building and Improving Agent Skills
question: What does conversation compaction do during a long task?

options.text: Summarizes earlier conversation for a smaller active context.
options.feedback: Compaction makes it possible to continue with less conversation in the active input. The summary can omit details, so important original evidence should remain available.

options.text: Copies every available project file into the next model input.
options.feedback: Compaction reduces the active conversation through summarization. Reading all project files would instead add material to the input.

options.text: Preserves every original detail in a shorter lossless transcript.
options.feedback: A summary is selective and can omit details that later matter. You should retain access to the original evidence.

options.text: Turns the current project record into a permanent personal preference.
options.feedback: Compaction summarizes task history. Changing project facts and recurring personal preferences have different roles.
